entry.name: cycle~
entry.description: Use the cycle~ object to generate a periodic waveform. The default waveform is one cycle of a cosine wave. You can also use the wave~ object, which offers additional flexibility though slightly less optimization.

arguments.name: buffer-name
arguments.description: The name of aobject used to define the oscillator's wavetable. If a frequency argument is present, thename follows the frequency. If noname is given,uses an internal 64-bit 16K cosine wavetable.

arguments.name: sample-offset
arguments.description: If aname has been given, this defines the sample offset into the namedobject's sample memory.only uses the first channel of a multi-channel.

attributes.name: buffer
attributes.digest: Buffer name
attributes.description: Buffer containing an external waveform. Setting thewith the attribute is analogous to sending themessage.

attributes.name: buffer_offset
attributes.digest: First sample of a buffer (if an external buffer is providing the waveform)

attributes.name: buffer_sizeinsamps
attributes.digest: Buffer size override flag
attributes.description: Override the size of the buffer used for the wavetable. If using themessage the size will be 512, or if using themessage the size will be the wholelength. Use this attribute to define a different size (the size should be a power of two). Setting this size to 0 will result in an effective size of 512 and setting it to -1 will result an effective size of the wholelength.

messages.name: float
messages.description: Left inlet: frequency of the oscillatorRight inlet: phase of the oscillator in the range 0.0 to 1.0

messages.name: reset
messages.description: In the left inlet, themessage, followed by a float from 0 - 1, resets the phase of theobject. Signal output continues from the specified phase. If you have multipleobjects that are out of phase, sending them all themessage will synchronize them.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Use 512 samples of aas a wavetable
messages.description: Set aobject to use as the wavetable, using the first 512 samples. If no name is given, the internal cosine wavetable with 16K samples will be used. Use themessage to use an entireas a wavetable.

messages.name: setall
messages.digest: Use the entire contents of aas a wavetable
messages.description: Set aobject to use as the wavetable, using the entirelength. This is in contrast to themessage which only uses the first 512 samples of the.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: Left inlet: frequency of the oscillatorRight inlet: phase of the oscillator in the range 0.0 to 1.0
